scientific_limitations: Only odd-first two-phase matching snapshots on a labelled path, with simultaneous layer-local forcing and horizon T.
Does not cover alternate uniqueness conventions or arbitrary temporal networks.
Numerical minima for alternating paths may already be in earlier work; the enumerative generating functions are the principal claim.
A plausible earlier manuscript advertising exact alternating-path values and the later sections of the motivating paper were not accessible for complete comparison.
Closely related all-size counting on two perfect matching alternating cycles is prior work; this theorem treats unmatched path boundaries and their rational length series, not the cyclic result.
title: Rational forcing-set generating functions for alternating-matching temporal paths
